name: DeleteRowFromDataTableNode
label: Delete Row From Data Table
description: Deletes a row from a data table based on its zero-based index.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table from which the row will be deleted.

fields.name: RowIndex
fields.label: Row Index
fields.description: The zero-based index of the row to delete.

fields.name: ModifiedDataTable
fields.label: Modified Data Table
fields.description: Returns the updated data table after the row is deleted.
